request.system:
You draft one IQ/OQ Test Step for one URS requirement of pharmaceutical equipment. You get the requirement with its verified value and Coverage class, the vendor Evidence linked to it with why it does not prove the requirement, and the pages of the source documents.
description: what the step verifies, one sentence.
method: how to perform it, executable at the site; test the upper and lower limits or the worst case where the requirement has them.
instrument: the measuring instrument to use; null when the step measures nothing.
acceptance: the Acceptance Criterion, only when a source page prints it. kind: range (min and/or max), number, one_of (accepted texts in allowed, exactly as printed), text, present (a feature that must exist), or none. Numbers are plain JSON numbers (Indonesian documents write 1.000 for one thousand and 0,5 for one half); unit: a short English unit symbol such as mm, kN, rpm or °C.
acceptance_source: where the AC is printed: doc and rev of one of the given sources, the page number and a verbatim quote, at most 200 characters, that states the AC with its numbers as printed. Copy characters exactly.
Never invent, round or tighten a limit. If no source prints an AC for this requirement, answer kind none and acceptance_source null: a human sets it.
request.user:
{
 "requirement": {
  "id": "URS-TP202-p1-04",
  "text": "Kapasitas produksi | Minimal 300.000 tablet/jam pada kecepatan turret maksimum. | Ya",
  "value": null,
  "value_citation": null,
  "coverage": "gap",
  "reason": "no FAT/SAT step addresses it"
 },
 "evidence": [],
 "sources": [
  {
   "doc": "URS-TP202",
   "rev": 0,
   "page": 1,
   "text": "Spesifikasi Kebutuhan Pengguna
TP-202 – Rotary tablet press (double-sided)
Nomor dokumen URS-TP202, revisi 0, berlaku sejak 16/07/2025.
Pendahuluan
Dokumen ini menguraikan kebutuhan PT Arunika Farma Lestari terhadap rotary tablet press (doublesided) TP-202. Kebutuhan dalam tabel yang ditandai Kritis = Ya berdampak langsung pada mutu produk atau keselamatan.
1. Kinerja mesin
Mesin akan digunakan untuk produksi tablet lepas cepat dengan volume tinggi di ruang cetak tablet.
Aspek Kebutuhan Kritis
Jumlah stasiun punch Minimal 45 stasiun punch. Tidak
Kecepatan turret Dapat diatur pada rentang 10–80 rpm. Ya
Kapasitas produksi Minimal 300.000 tablet/jam pada kecepatan turret maksimum. Ya
Gaya tekan utama Minimal 80 kN. Ya
Gaya pra-kompresi Minimal 20 kN. Tidak
2. Material dan permukaan
Bagian ini berlaku untuk semua komponen yang bersentuhan langsung dengan serbuk atau tablet.
Aspek Kebutuhan Kritis
Material bagian kontak produk Baja tahan karat SS 316L. Ya
Kekasaran permukaan bagian kontak produk Ra maksimal 0,8 µm. Tidak
3. Sistem kendali dan data
Mesin dikendalikan melalui PLC dengan panel HMI layar sentuh di sisi operator. Mesin dilengkapi kontrol bobot tablet otomatis berdasarkan gaya tekan. Data batch dan resep dicadangkan otomatis ke server site setiap hari.
4. Keselamatan dan lingkungan kerja
Mesin dipasang di ruang cetak tablet bersama dua mesin lain dan dioperasikan oleh satu operator per shift. Tingkat kebisingan pada jarak 1 m dari mesin tidak lebih dari 80 dB(A). Pintu pelindung dilengkapi interlock yang menghentikan mesin ketika pintu dibuka. Tombol henti darurat tersedia di panel operator dan di sisi belakang mesin.
5. Utilitas
Utilitas disediakan oleh site sampai titik sambung di samping mesin. Mesin beroperasi dengan udara tekan site pada tekanan 6–7 bar.
Riwayat dokumen
Revisi 0, 16/07/2025: Terbitan pertama."
  }
 ]
}

response.text: {"description":"Verify that the rotary tablet press produces at least 300.000 tablets per hour when running at maximum turret speed.","method":"Set the turret speed to its maximum setpoint (80 rpm per URS section 1 range 10–80 rpm), run the machine with production tooling for a timed interval long enough to collect a representative sample, count the tablets discharged, and calculate tablets per hour; confirm the calculated rate is at least 300.000 tablets/jam.","instrument":"Calibrated stopwatch and precision balance or tablet counter","acceptance":{"kind":"range","min":300000,"max":null,"number":null,"unit":"tablet/h","allowed":[],"text":null},"acceptance_source":{"doc":"URS-TP202","rev":0,"page":1,"quote":"Kapasitas produksi | Minimal 300.000 tablet/jam pada kecepatan turret maksimum. | Ya"}}
